objective: Find the best generalizing checkpoint and useful training horizon for the Experiment 27 GPT without repeating a full three-epoch run.

protocol.full_validation: exp23.validate_epoch over the entire held-out split
protocol.periodic_validation: exp23.validate_epoch over the first periodic_val_batches validation batches
protocol.train_subset: exp23.validate_epoch over the first train_subset_batches training batches (shuffle=False, eval mode); used as a fixed train-loss reference
protocol.scheduler: exp23.WarmupCosineScheduler, one step per optimizer update

shared: 30M architecture, tokenizer, vocabulary, and pg1342 split
seed 0 initialization via _set_global_seed before model construction
data ordering reset to seed 0 immediately before training
BF16 autocast with FP32 cross-entropy reduction
differences: pilot warmup was 2,000 of 3,000 steps (66.7%); Experiment 27 used 0.77% and Experiment 28 scales that fraction
pilot decayed from peak to 1e-4 over the final 1,000 steps; Experiment 28 horizons decay over their full planned budget
pilot evaluated the first 25 val batches; Experiment 28 uses the first 100
pilot generated samples with one prompt and 8 new tokens; Experiment 28 uses the five default prompts and 40 new tokens
pilot_audit.comparable_use: The pilot is used only as motivation and as a coarse lower bound on early validation loss, not as a direct horizon comparison.
